title: Fixed Reclined Chair and Connected Dental Unit
description: One newly authored complete fixed dental-unit-style equipment exterior, counted as one prop and zero scenes. A low broad grounded pedestal supports one continuous leg-seat-inclined-back shell and thick pad with a separate fixed headrest and open-side arm supports. A physically connected side column carries a true open rinse bowl and curved fixed spout. On the opposite side, two complete fixed support arms carry an empty tray and three short attached hoses with blunt parked handpiece exteriors. A tall mast with two whole angled arms supports an opaque examination-light head and two grip loops over the empty chair. No old chair geometry imported, recoloured or merely reclined. Three constant opaque untextured materials, all parts newly authored and editable. Static unoccupied artistic equipment appearance only: no patient, clinical procedure, diagnosis/treatment, medical suitability, water/plumbing, powered light, electrical function, real mechanism motion, ergonomics, hygiene, load, manufacture or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
